concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-avs-cvv-responses]] - AVS postal/street and CVV match, mismatch, not-verified, not-provided, unsupported or nonparticipating, not-applicable and skipped response categories, plus AVS system-error semantics and an unreconstructed response-object evidence gap
warnings: Do not reconstruct the missing response-object names or infer SDK field placement from the damaged introduction.
Keep `U` distinct from `N`: not verified may reflect an authorization decline before the bank evaluates the supplied value.
Preserve that CVV `I` can also occur for a transaction made with a vaulted payment method.
Do not infer transaction approval, decline, fraud disposition or retry behavior from an AVS/CVV category alone.
Keep the linked Vault rules as navigation-only until fully read.
